item.title: NeuroScientific Biopharmaceuticals Reports Strong Results from Stem Cell Study on Fistulising Crohn's Disease
item.description: NeuroScientific Biopharmaceuticals (ASX: NSB) has confirmed that 75% of patients in the first cohort of a study into its StemSmart therapy to treat fistulising Crohn’s disease have demonstrated a positive clinical response following treatment.

item.title: Galilee Energy Adds to Leaseholding at Zydeco Gas Project in Louisiana
item.description: Galilee Energy (ASX: GLL) has secured additional lease agreements associated with the Zydeco project on the US Gulf Coast, expanding the gas and condensate field to now cover a leased area of more than 325 acres.

item.title: Alligator Energy Further De-Risks ISR Development Pathway with Samphire Pilot Plant Completion
item.description: Alligator Energy (ASX: AGE) has successfully completed construction of its Samphire pilot plant, advancing to the critical Field Recovery Trial phase with results expected in Q1 2026, a key de-risking event for its in-situ recovery uranium development pathway.

item.title: The Calmer Co Records Highest Monthly Revenue to Date Across Wholesale and Retail Channels
item.description: Beverage business The Calmer Co International (ASX: CCO) has delivered its strongest single-month performance since listing on the Australian Securities Exchange in 2018, with unaudited sales of $910,767 in December.

item.title: Resolution Minerals Continues to Highlight Horse Heaven’s Antimony Potential
item.description: Resolution Minerals (ASX: RML) believes that the quality of new results from its Horse Heaven project in Idaho further highlights its potential to support the USA's critical mineral needs.

item.title: betr Entertainment Reports 24.5% Growth in Turnover, Launches On-Market Share Buyback Scheme
item.description: Pure-play digital wagering operator betr Entertainment (ASX: BBT) has reported a 24.5% growth in turnover from 163,504 active customers during the three months to end December.

item.title: Red Mountain Mining Returns up to 34.3% Antimony from Sampling at Oaky Creek Prospect
item.description: Red Mountain Mining (ASX: RMX) has returned high-grade antimony assays from 13 rock chip samples at the Oaky Creek prospect within its Armidale antimony-gold project in New South Wales.

item.title: Terra Metals Confirms Further PGM Discovery at Dante’s Southwest Prospect
item.description: Terra Metals (ASX:TM1) has made a second platinum group metal discovery at the Southwest prospect within its Dante project in Western Australia, confirming mineralisation occurs across separate sections of the Southwest area.

item.title: Mithril Silver and Gold Starts Maiden Drilling Campaign at Copalquin District’s Target 3
item.description: Mithril Silver and Gold (ASX: MTH) has commenced a 3,300-metre drilling campaign at Target 3 within its Copalquin District gold-silver project in Mexico’s Durango state.

item.title: Kuniko Prepares for Phase 1 Drilling at Commonwealth Project under Earn-In Agreement with Impact Minerals
item.description: Under an earn-in and joint venture agreement with project owner Impact Minerals (ASX: IPT), Kuniko (ASX: KNI) has completed a MobileMT airborne electromagnetic program over 328 line-km of the Commonwealth gold-silver-copper project in NSW.
